visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a pair of hands holding a pink plate filled with chopped white radish, orange carrots, and green celery. The setting is a brightly lit, clean indoor kitchen with a wooden table. The hands then place a plate of yellow corn sections and a plate of cooked meat bones on the table. (2) The scene shifts to showing two small white bowls containing peppercorns and fennel seeds, along with two bay leaves. The main character, wearing a pink apron, puts the spices into a small white cloth bag and uses the bottom of a stainless steel pitcher to gently tap the bag on a wooden cutting board to release the aroma. (3) The ingredients—onions, chopped vegetables, blanched pork and chicken bones, corn, leeks, garlic, ginger slices, and the spice bag—are sequentially added into a large stainless steel pot on a black induction stove. Clear liquid is poured from a pitcher into the pot. (4) As the liquid boils, the person uses a fine mesh strainer to skim off white foam from the surface. A pressure cooker lid is then secured onto the pot, and a golden valve on top begins to spin and release steam. (5) After cooking, the lid is removed to reveal a rich yellow broth. The broth is poured through a large metal strainer into a stainless steel bowl. The person uses a ladle to press down on the cooked vegetables in the strainer to extract every drop of liquid. Finally, the clear golden broth is poured into two white rectangular storage containers.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a light, airy acoustic BGM featuring a strummed guitar and melodic piano notes. A female narrator speaks in a calm, welcoming tone, introducing the process of preparing vegetables. (2) As the vegetables are shown, a sharp metallic click of the spice pitcher hitting the wooden board is heard. (3) The sound of liquid pouring from a container into a metal pot creates a distinct splashing noise. (4) A mechanical clicking sound is heard as the lid of the pressure cooker is locked into place. (5) A high-pitched, rhythmic rhythmic 'shshsh' sound of steam escaping from the pressure cooker's valve dominates the mid-section of the audio. (6) The sound of liquid straining and splashing into a metal bowl follows as the broth is filtered. (7) The narrator's voice remains consistently friendly and clear throughout the ending, providing a summary of the resulting broth, layered over the continuous, upbeat BGM.
